title: Related-Key Differential Bounds for SIMON
summary: No related-key differential-characteristic bound is known for any SIMON version; the open task is to find meaningful bounds or determine whether high-probability characteristics exist.

formal_statement.body: For the SIMON family of ciphers, no differential-characteristic bound is known in the related-key model for any version. Establish meaningful related-key differential-characteristic bounds for SIMON, or determine whether high-probability related-key differential characteristics exist for any version.

scope.domain: Related-key differential cryptanalysis of the SIMON block-cipher family.
assumptions: The differential analysis is conducted in the related-key model.
parameters: SIMON version — identifies which member of the cipher family is analyzed
scope.unresolved_remainder: Establish meaningful related-key differential-characteristic bounds for SIMON, or determine whether high-probability related-key differential characteristics exist for any version.

citations.label: The SKINNY Family of Block Ciphers and Its Low-Latency Variant MANTIS

progress.summary: The source presents the absence of any related-key bound for SIMON as a security gap and warns that good related-key differential characteristics may exist.
citation_labels: Christof Beierle et al., The SKINNY Family of Block Ciphers and Its Low-Latency Variant MANTIS
